name: alert_noise_reduction
description:
Alert noise reduction as a single deterministic triage node. The model proposes
exactly one typed operational context (cause_group, release_correlation,
business_period); this workflow owns the metric threshold, the trend, the
dedupe/cooldown windows, the severity composition, and the final
suppress/escalate decision. Port of code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/alert_noise_reduction.
Thresholds are per metric (cpu_percent 85, p95_latency_ms 500, error_rate_percent
5, disk_used_percent 85, queue_depth 1000, memory_percent 90); breach folds the
ratio latest/threshold >= 1 into a band. The dedupe (300s) and cooldown (900s)
windows are clock/fingerprint state and fold into one stream choice. Effective
severity folds base severity (ratio band) plus the release-correlation and
business-period modifiers into one choice. The emitted label is the engine's
action code: escalate is exactly {page, ticket}; suppress is
{clear, duplicate, cooldown, low_severity, reject_context}.

context_schema.instructions: Is the model's typed context one schema-valid proposal (exactly cause_group / release_correlation / business_period, all enum values, no threshold / trend / severity / decision / action field)?

criteria.rejected: malformed, unknown enum, or a forbidden local field

breach.instructions: Did the latest sample breach this metric's configured threshold (ratio = latest / threshold >= 1)?

stream.instructions: Fingerprint state for this service+metric+cause_group: has an identical alert already fired?

criteria.first_seen: no alert for this fingerprint inside dedupe (300s) or cooldown (900s)
criteria.duplicate: identical alert already fired within the dedupe window
criteria.cooldown: identical alert already acted on within the cooldown window

trend.instructions: Trend of the sample window (least-squares slope compared with 2% of the threshold)?

criteria.stable: otherwise, or fewer than three samples

release_correlation.instructions: Model context: does the alert correlate with an active release?

criteria.not_correlated: a release is known but unrelated

business_period.instructions: Model context: which business period is the alert in?

severity.instructions: Effective severity of the breach: base from the ratio band (warning 1.0<=r<1.2, high 1.2<=r<1.5, critical r>=1.5), raised when release_correlation=correlated and trend=rising, raised when business_period=business_peak and (ratio>=1.2 or trend=rising), lowered when business_period=off_peak and trend=falling and ratio<1.5.

criteria.warning: breaches but below the page line; files a ticket
